facts.fact: Adwave states that CPMs for streaming TV ads on its platform are expected to fall between $15 and $35, averaging about $25 for small business campaigns.
facts.quote: expect CPMs between $15-35, averaging around $25 for small business campaigns.

facts.fact: Adwave's example calculation says a $100 budget at a $25 CPM delivers 4,000 impressions.
Adwave estimates that 4,000 impressions reach approximately 1,000-1,500 unique households with an average frequency of 3-4 times per household.
Adwave says a $100 Facebook campaign might deliver about 2,000 impressions with a 90% scroll-past rate and no sound.
facts.quote: Compare that to $100 on Facebook, where you might get 2,000 impressions but with 90% scroll-past rates and no sound.

facts.fact: The page states that traditional TV commercials cost $5,000-50,000 to produce, before any airtime spending.
Adwave's AI generates a 30-second broadcast-quality TV ad in about 3-5 minutes.
For local businesses, Adwave describes a typical targeting radius of 10-25 miles.
facts.quote: Radius: Set how far you want to reach (10-25 miles typical)

facts.fact: Adwave's default campaign schedule is a 2-week run starting the next day.
facts.quote: Default is a 2-week run starting the next day.

facts.fact: Adwave states that campaigns go live within 24 hours of launch.
facts.quote: Your campaign will be live within 24 hours.

facts.fact: Adwave says the minimum test budget suggested is $100, with a $50 option for an even smaller test.
facts.quote: Enter $100 (or start with $50 if you want an even smaller test).

facts.fact: Adwave's benchmark for a successful $100 test is 3,000-5,000 impressions delivered, while under 2,000 impressions indicates a problem.
Adwave estimates that a $500 per month budget yields about 20,000 impressions and reaches 5,000+ unique households.
Adwave estimates that a $1,000 per month budget yields about 40,000 impressions and reaches 10,000+ unique households.
Adwave says a professional commercial can be running on NBC, Hulu, ESPN, and 100+ premium channels with $100 and one hour.
facts.quote: With $100 and one hour, you can have a professional commercial running on NBC, Hulu, ESPN, and 100+ premium channels by tomorrow.

facts.fact: Adwave states that platforms designed for small businesses allow campaigns starting at $50 to $100.
facts.quote: Yes, platforms designed for small businesses now allow campaigns starting at $50 to $100.

facts.fact: Adwave says typical CTV CPMs are $20 to $30.
facts.quote: At typical CTV CPMs of $20 to $30, a $100 budget delivers approximately 3,000 to 5,000 impressions.

facts.fact: Adwave says users only pay when they are ready to launch a campaign, and creating the ad can be done for free.
facts.quote: [Create your ad for free with Adwave](https://adwave.com/try-free/). You only pay when you're ready to launch.
